study: Second seeds at full size: the Transformer at 90,000 updates, both models at 180,000
kind: pre-registration of three full-size runs on the server's GPUs, in the window Daniel opened until Thursday 2026-12-03 07:45 Berlin
why: Every full-size comparison so far pairs the stack with one Transformer run, fsp-tf (seed 20001). The stack's two seeds at 90,000 updates lie 0.0001 apart on test and 0.0003 on validation (full_size_power_cells_second_seed.json), but the Transformer's spread at full size has never been measured, and that record named a second Transformer seed as owed before any full-size claim. The data slope (full_size_data_slope.json) has one seed a length and sets its mark above a spread it does not measure. Its pair at 180,000 updates is the longest training either model has had, the length at which a stack that keeps learning with data would show it. On 2026-11-28 Daniel opened the server's GPUs until Thursday 2026-12-03 07:45 Berlin ("we can use the server 24/7 until thursday next week"), which leaves room for second seeds of both runs at 180,000 updates (about 12 and 4 hours with their scoring) and of the Transformer at 90,000 (about 3 hours). This record fixes how they are read before any Transformer run at 180,000 updates has trained.

arms.fsp-tf-s2: fsp-tf's recipe (full_size_best_rate_pair.json) with seed 20002: sched/bin/full-pair5.sh transformer fsp-tf-s2 1.2e-3 with SEED=20002, on the code copy v17l (072eb90) that trained fsp-tf, 90,000 updates forked at 24,000, no speed switches (fsp-tf had none); 34,752,000 parameters.
arms.fsd-tf-180k-s2: fsd-tf-180k's recipe (full_size_data_slope.json) with seed 20002: full-pair5.sh transformer fsd-tf-180k-s2 1.2e-3 with SEED=20002, STEPS=180000, FORK=48000, on v17l.
arms.fsd-st-180k-s2: fsd-st-180k's recipe with seed 20002: full-pair5.sh stack fsd-st-180k-s2 6e-4 --stack-loop 2,8,2 --pulse-budget 507000 --pool-lifts-ceiling --granule-power 8 --fused-reads with SEED=20002, STEPS=180000, FORK=48000, on the code copy v18o (a418100) that trained fsd-st-180k, with its read (fused reads in both stages) and no other switch; 36,263,956 parameters in the long stage, 507,000 pulses a byte as budget. The fused optimizer and the exact products, which change no bit, are left off, so that the run differs from fsd-st-180k by its seed alone.
arms.data and schedule: As the first seeds: 4,096 bytes an update from the enwik8, C4 and PG-19 mixture at weights 2:1:1 (737 M training bytes at 180,000 updates, enwik8's 90 M training bytes seen about 4.1 times; 369 M at 90,000), one cosine with 1,000 warm-up updates, windows of 512 bytes to the fork, then the long stage (the stack on unbroken streams of windows of 2,048 with 128 knowledge cells a head and a reach of 2,048, the Transformer on windows of 2,048).

measure.stack (primary, as full_size_power_cells: Read without fast output synapses, as experiments/eval_stream.py reads a stream, at the reach chosen on the first 1,000,000 validation bytes between the trained 2,048 and 8,192, over the full enwik8 test and validation splits as 16 unbroken streams.
measure.Transformer: Frozen, in windows of 2,048 bytes with 2,032 of history (full_size_best_rate_pair.json).
measure.pairing: Piece by piece with experiments/compare_stream_scores.py, the 95% interval from resampled pieces. The mean of two seeds is the mean of their bits, byte by byte.
measure.beside: The stack taught (fast output synapses at 2^24 on all 18 passes, as full-pair5.sh scores it, and at the threshold fast_synapse_threshold_power.json adopts, if it adopts one), the Transformer with fast synapses at 0.07, the pulses a byte, the training times, and experiments/gap_by_piece.py by context.

reading.(1) the Transformer's spread at 90,000: fsp-tf-s2 against fsp-tf, frozen, on each split, paired, with its interval. Reported.
reading.(2) the stack against two Transformer se: The mean of fsp-lift2's and fsp-lift2-s2's primary bits against the mean of fsp-tf's and fsp-tf-s2's frozen bits, and fsp-lift2-s2 against fsp-tf-s2, on each split. Reported. The verdict of full_size_power_cells_second_seed.json stands as recorded, whatever this shows.
reading.(3) the spread at 180,000: fsd-st-180k-s2 against fsd-st-180k (primary) and fsd-tf-180k-s2 against fsd-tf-180k (frozen), on each split. Reported beside the data slope's reading, which stays as its record registered it (one seed a length, the stack's taught score).
reading.(4) the win rule at 180,000 updates: Fixed here, before any Transformer run at 180,000 updates has trained. The stack beats a Transformer of its size trained on the same data at 180,000 updates if all three of these hold on test and on validation, each with the paired 95% interval below zero: (a) fsd-st-180k-s2's primary score is below fsd-tf-180k-s2's frozen score; (b) fsd-st-180k's primary score is below fsd-tf-180k's frozen score; (c) the two stack seeds' mean is below the two Transformer seeds' mean. If they all hold on one split and an interval includes zero on the other, the stack is ahead on that split and level on the other, which is not beating. Every claim states the pulses a byte, the two seeds a side, that the stack is read without its fast output synapses, and that the training mixture repeats (enwik8 about 4.1 times).
reading.(5) repeated data: The data slope's reading (3) applies to both seeds: a model whose two seeds score worse on validation at 180,000 updates than its two seeds at 90,000 overfits the repeated mixture, and any claim at 180,000 says so.
reading.scope: One data mixture, enwik8's test and validation splits, one size, two seeds a side.

what follows: If (4) holds, Volley beats a Transformer of its size trained on the same data at 180,000 updates: the claim is made with its limits in a release, and the next step is the data slope's (2), longer training on more data for both models; new data needs Daniel's consent before anything is downloaded. If (4) fails, the gap at 180,000 is reported with its spread, and the next full-size step follows the data slope's verdict and cubic_cells_with_data.json. These runs repeat earlier recipes with another seed: they are not the next full-length run in which cubic_cells_with_data.json would put the cube.
where: Each run alone on its GPU (MPS=0, GPU_MEM=85). GPU 0: fsp-tf-s2 and then fsd-tf-180k-s2 after fsd-st-45k, the data slope's last run (about 3 and 4 hours); the bed runs waiting there start after them. All three should be scored by Sunday 2026-11-29 morning, inside the window; a pause resumes from the last saved state.
seen_before_recording: Every result of full_size_power_cells_second_seed.json, full_size_lifted_loop_second.json and the earlier full-size records, with fsp-tf's scores. Of the data slope: fsd-st-180k's scan of the first million validation bytes at the reach of 8,192 (1.085103) and the trainers' validation curves of fsd-st-180k and fsd-tf-45k so far; fsd-st-180k's test and validation scores exist on the server and no loop session has read them.
